item.title: Food program provides thousands of meals for children this summer
item.description:
Food program provides thousands of meals for children this summer jpranahan Thu, 08/27/2026 - 08:32

More than 1,000 Island children from across the province received healthy meals through the summer food program this year. 

Throughout the summer months, precooked, frozen meals that can be reheated were delivered directly to Island family homes with school-aged children. As of August 26, 51,231 meals have been served, with approximately 58,000 meals projected to be delivered by the end of the program.

"This is a wonderful program that helps ensure Island children have access to nutritious meals throughout the summer months. Thank you to the local food vendors and the delivery drivers from across the province who helped make this year's program such a success."

- Social Development and Seniors Minister Barb Ramsay

Since launching on July 8, the program has provided weekly meal deliveries every Wednesday and will continue through September 2, 2026. Meals were prepared by eight local food vendors located across the province. Registration for the program is now closed.

"Pure Kitchen has always held the view that in a prosperous country such as ours, no-one should ever go hungry," said owner of Pure Kitchen Catering Chef John Pritchard. "We believe it is our ethical responsibility to help whenever possible when it comes to food security. Whether we're preparing meals for the Summer Food Program, the PEI School Food Program or providing meals through our own community food efforts, we do what we can, when we can, as often as we can." 

Visit the Summer Food Program to learn more.

item.title: New disc golf course open at Brudenell River Provincial Park
item.description:
New disc golf course open at Brudenell River Provincial Park ssdrummond Wed, 08/26/2026 - 15:40

Residents and visitors can enjoy a new family-friendly 18-hole disc golf course at Brudenell River Provincial Park with the opening of Divine Pines at Brudenell. 

Designed by Benjamin Smith, the course is located on the former Divine Nine golf course and combines open fairways, lightly wooded sections and gentle elevation changes to offer an enjoyable experience for players of all skill levels. Features from the former golf course, including sand bunkers and raised tee boxes, have been incorporated into the design, creating unique challenges and strategic shot opportunities.

The cost to play is $10 per person, plus HST. Players can pay using the QR code located at the first tee or at the Brudenell Park Campground office. Tee times are not required. Players are encouraged to bring their own discs or rent a pack of three discs for $2.

Tourism PEI continues to invest in experiences that showcase the Island's natural beauty and encourage visitors to explore Prince Edward Island in every season. Open year-round, Divine Pines adds a unique outdoor activity to eastern PEI and supports opportunities to attract visitors beyond the peak summer season.


Quotes:

"Brudenell River Provincial Park is one of Prince Edward Island's premier outdoor destinations, and we're pleased to offer visitors another way to experience it. Divine Pines at Brudenell builds on the park's recreational offerings and creates new opportunities for residents and visitors to enjoy the Island throughout the year."

  • Minister of Fisheries, Rural Development and Tourism Ernie Hudson

"The new disc golf course, Divine Pines at Brudenell, is the perfect blend of sweet and challenging.  The layout offers a great opportunity for people to come and experience disc golf for the first time, or for experienced players to let loose and watch some discs fly! Once you try it, we know you’ll love it."

  • Course designer Benjamin Smith

"The Province of PEI has been an integral partner in the growth of our sport. They have continued to believe in the economic impact and accessibility of disc golf, helping shape PEI into a destination for disc golfers far and wide. The Divine Pines at Brudenell property is truly unique, and the course design is perfect for new and experienced players alike."

  • President of Disc Golf PEI James Mallard

For more information about the disc golf course visit the Divine Pines at Brudenell

Media Contact:
Jill Edwards
Department of Fisheries, Rural Development and Tourism
Jedwards@gov.pe.ca

Backgrounder:

The final event of the 2026 Disc Golf PEI Tour will take place over two days, September 26 and 27 at the Belfast Disc Golf Course and the Divine Pines at Brudenell.  

Divine Pines will host the final round on Sunday, September 27 with tee times scheduled between

9-11:30 a.m. The event is open to the public.

For more information about the 2026 Disc Golf PEI Tour visit www.discgolfpei.com

item.title: Premier McLeod on the Enbridge Line 21 Pipeline
item.description:
YELLOWKNIFE - Premier Bob McLeod issued the following statement on the Enbridge Line 21 pipeline today:

“I was pleased to learn that operations have resumed for Enbridge’s Line 21 pipeline after almost 2 years of no activity.

"Resource development has, and will continue to be, the backbone of our economy and is central to ensuring a good source of middle class jobs and business opportunities. Our territory has mineral and petroleum resources and the development of those resources can have a transformative effect on our people and economy.

"Sustainable economic development is key to the future of Northerners. With a strong resource development base, we will be able to support diversification of our local economies into emerging and established sectors.

"On behalf of the Government of the Northwest Territories I’d like to offer my congratulations to Imperial Oil, Enbridge the town of Norman Wells and other partners for getting this pipeline back up and running. I know the efforts and economic impacts of the pipeline have already begun to take shape in the community and will be felt for years to come. ”

 

Charlotte Digness
Media and Communications Coordinator
Cabinet Communications and Protocol
Government of the Northwest Territories
